calculus/fundamental-theorem-calculus.cipher: THE WINDING KEY IS IN THE CUCKOO CLOCK
calculus/fundamental-theorem-calculus.outro: TICKS sets every clock right and the workshop door chimes open.

calculus/applications-integrals.title: Wind Farm Power Grid
calculus/applications-integrals.intro: The wind farm's grid shut down after a storm. Net change, area and volume unlock each turbine in 10 minutes.
calculus/applications-integrals.cipher: THE RESET SWITCH IS BY THE SUBSTATION
calculus/applications-integrals.outro: POWER flows again and the town lights come back on.

calculus/differential-equations.title: Wildlife Population Reserve
calculus/differential-equations.intro: The reserve's population models crashed and every habitat gate locked. Slope fields, Euler's method and separable equations unlock each habitat in 10 minutes.
calculus/differential-equations.cipher: THE RANGER KEY IS AT THE WATERING HOLE
calculus/differential-equations.outro: HERDS balances the model and the reserve gates open.

calculus/ap-review.title: AP Exam Escape Marathon
calculus/ap-review.intro: The night before the AP exam, the review center locked its doors. Limits, derivatives, integrals and justifications unlock each exam room in 10 minutes.
calculus/ap-review.cipher: THE ANSWER SHEET IS UNDER THE STOPWATCH
calculus/ap-review.outro: GRADS! You conquered the review and walk out ready for exam day.
